name: ReadFormulaFromExcel
label: Read Formula from Excel Cell
description: Reads the formula from a specific cell or named range in Excel.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object from which the formula will be read. If not provided, the active worksheet will be used.

fields.name: ReferenceType
fields.label: Reference Type
fields.description: Specifies whether to reference by cell address or named range.

selectOptions.label: Cell Address
selectOptions.description: Reference by cell address (e.g., A1, B2)

fields.name: CellAddress
fields.label: Cell Address
fields.description: The address of the cell to read (e.g., 'A1', 'B2').

fields.name: NamedRange
fields.label: Named Range
fields.description: The name of the range to read the formula from.

fields.name: CellFormula
fields.label: Cell Formula
fields.description: The formula contained in the specified cell or range.
